name: Slack Inbox
description: Cross-platform inbox spike: inject one 'discord - <name>' row per real Discord DM channel under the bowei sidebar section and render the real conversation in the message pane over CDP — rendered like a real aubergine Slack channel (message kit, hover actions, selection state, working composer). Discord data comes host-side via latchkey (user-session or bot token); falls back to a fake conversation when creds/bridge are unavailable. Exposes window.__ewInbox capture hooks for an e2e dev harness.
